title: Walnut Wrap
description: A flavorful and filling vegan wrap filled with roasted vegetables and crunchy walnut. Perfect for a quick and easy snack or lunch.
instructions: Toss the eggplant and red bell pepper with olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a separate bowl, mix together the chopped parsley, mint, walnuts, hummus, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Warm the wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
Spread a layer of the parsley-mint-walnut mixture on the wrap, leaving a small border around the edges.
Add the roasted eggplant and red bell pepper on top of the mixture.
Season with unique seasoning blend to taste.
Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a tight cylinder.
Slice in half and serve immediately.
